decisions.reason: Data format reader and writer plug-ins build directly on the firm's core data integration expertise and standards participation, and their own web page signals an established product line it can readily improve.

A building data digital twin service is a newer area with weaker ties to the firm's core knowledge and only a website mention, but its research activity gives it the capacity to learn from early results, so it is retained for now.
Authentication and identity delegation fits the firm's integration and managed operations know-how, though its overlap with the identity service raises some risk of consolidation.
An open GIS application development framework is the heart of the firm's open, extensible component strategy and draws on decades of related knowledge, making it a strategic keep.
The identity service for GIS applications was actively promoted at launch as enabling seamless integration, and it builds on the firm's GIS platform expertise, so it is kept.
